findings.evidence: An unauthenticated request received administrative application configuration
findings.title: Private information is visible without signing in
findings.description: Someone who is not signed in was able to open an area that should be private.
findings.remediation: Require sign-in and check the person’s permissions before showing private information.

findings.evidence: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * on http://localhost:3000/rest/products/search?q=apple
findings.title: The site accepts requests from any website
findings.description: Another website may be allowed to ask this site for information.
findings.remediation: Allow requests only from websites that you trust.

findings.evidence: The website response did not include: Content-Security-Policy (limits what browser content can run), Referrer-Policy (limits URL information shared with other sites), Permissions-Policy (limits access to browser capabilities)
findings.title: Some browser safety settings are missing
findings.description: The website does not tell browsers to apply several helpful safety restrictions.
findings.remediation: Add a Content Security Policy, Referrer Policy, and Permissions Policy appropriate for the application.

findings.evidence: An unauthenticated request to /rest/order-history returned HTTP 500 with technical error detail 'stack'
findings.title: Error messages reveal too much detail
findings.description: An unusual request caused the site to reveal details about how it works.
findings.remediation: Show visitors a simple error message and keep technical details in private server logs.
